source.check: votes read from the result report; 1,224 + 861 + 7 = 2,092 agrees with the printed total poll

note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 19 September 1946, withdrawals to 20 September, and the day of election was Thursday 3 October 1946 (official notice, Belfast News-Letter, 6 September 1946, p. 2). Polling took place on 3 October ('Polling took place ... yesterday', Belfast News-Letter, 4 October 1946, p. 3) and the count was held on 4 October. No party labels were printed. Added from reports of the new council's meetings early in the term, each division inferred from the previous return: Portrush.
